verdict.rationale: Jitsu Functions are JavaScript/TypeScript code that runs before data is sent to a destination and can filter, transform and enrich events. A privacy lead could therefore hand-code hashing, masking or field removal per destination pipeline. The evidence shows no built-in PII controls, so this is a custom-code workaround rather than a dedicated privacy feature. Missing for 10: native hashing/masking primitives, declarative field-level PII filtering per destination, PII detection or classification, and documentation or independent corroboration of PII-specific use.
